relations.description: Fallback indication triggers UE to enter 5GMM-IDLE mode.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain Uplink data status IE.
SERVICE REQUEST message may contain Uplink data status IE.
Registration procedure includes sending REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
Service request procedure includes sending SERVICE REQUEST message.
Presence of pending uplink data triggers service request procedure.
Pending de-registration procedure affects UE behavior after fallback.
Allowed area condition affects inclusion of Uplink data status IE.
UE request type IE value affects inclusion of Uplink data status IE.
Fallback indication may trigger registration procedure.
Fallback indication may trigger service request procedure.
UE transitions from 5GMM-CONNECTED to 5GMM-IDLE mode upon fallback.
